DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。締切の日に相談を予約すれば、提出も間に合いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 締切当日の相談で提出が間に合うか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. If I book a consultation on the deadline date, will I still have time to submit everything?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a consultation on the deadline date leaves enough time to submit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相談しただけで提出が完了するわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Simply having a consultation does not mean your submission is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね。追加の書類が必要なら、その日では遅いかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 追加資料の時間不足を認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's true. If additional documents are required, that day might be too late.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that there may not be enough time for additional documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通知に必要書類の記載はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Does the notice list the required documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありますが、手元にない書類もあります。先に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不足書類ありの早期相談を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, but there are some documents I don't have with me. I'd like to consult someone first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request an early consultation because some documents are missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相談の候補日を確認します。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。期限は変わったと思わず、用意できない物も担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 期限不変と不足申告を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I won't assume the deadline has changed, and I'll tell the person in charge which items I can't prepare.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the deadline stays the same and missing documents must be reported. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通知の原本をお持ちください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。予約日と提出期限を、メモの別の行に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相談日と提出期限を別記する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll write the appointment date and the submission deadline on separate lines in my notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record the consultation date and submission deadline separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 早めの相談候補をご案内します。提出期限や不足書類の扱いは担当へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll suggest some early consultation dates. Please check the submission deadline and how missing documents will be handled with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 紹介状や検査結果はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a referral letter or test results?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 検査結果があります。ただ、最近ではなく、去年のものです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 過去検査資料の持参時期を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have test results. They aren't recent, though; they're from last year.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State when the past test documents you brought are from. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 検査した日付は書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the date of the test written on them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。この上の欄です。今日の状態を示す資料だとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 検査日を指し現在結果と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, in this field at the top. I don't regard them as showing my condition today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the test date and distinguish the results from current findings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 過去の資料として担当へお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll give them to the person in charge as past records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。別の病院で受けた検査だということも伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他院検査という出所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Please also tell them that the tests were done at another hospital.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the tests came from another hospital. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 資料の原本をお預かりしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: May we keep the original documents for now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日だけ預けます。返してもらえるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原本の返却扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll leave them with you just for today. I'd like to check whether I'll get them back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how the originals will be returned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返却方法も担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll also check the return arrangements with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。資料は一冊です。お渡しした数を控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 預ける冊数を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. There is one booklet. I'll note how many I handed over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record the number of booklets you are leaving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一冊を過去資料としてお預かりします。返却のご希望も担当者へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll take this one booklet as past records. I'll also tell the person in charge that you would like it returned.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾われた物をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you brought something you found?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。携帯電話です。着信がありましたが、出ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾得電話と未応答着信を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, a mobile phone. It rang, but I didn't answer it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the found phone and the unanswered incoming call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見つけた場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me where you found it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 公園のベンチの下です。画面を開いて持ち主を探すことはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発見場所と未開錠を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Under a bench in the park. I haven't opened the screen to look for the owner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe where you found it and say you have not unlocked it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのままの状態でお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll take it in its current condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。雨にぬれそうだったので、袋に入れて持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 雨避けの袋収納を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. It looked as though it might get wet in the rain, so I put it in a bag and brought it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you put it in a bag to protect it from the rain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかに動かした物はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話だけです。周りに鞄などは見ませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話以外の発見物がないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Just the phone. I didn't see a bag or anything like that nearby.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State that you found nothing besides the phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 拾った時刻はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you know what time you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 十分ほど前です。正確な分は覚えていないので、おおよその時刻で伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 拾得時刻を概算として示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: About ten minutes ago. I don't remember the exact minute, so I'll give an approximate time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the time you found it as an estimate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 現状と発見場所、時刻を記録します。中の情報には触れず、こちらで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll record its condition and where and when it was found. We'll check it here without accessing the information inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居先の住所についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the address you're moving to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。親族の家へ移ります。郵便受けには親族の名字だけあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新居郵便受けの別姓表示を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'm moving into a relative's home. Only my relative's surname is on the mailbox.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a different surname being displayed on the mailbox at your new home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様とは違う名字ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's a different surname from yours, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。表札を親族の名前に合わせて、私の宛名も変えるべきですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表札に合わせ本人宛名変更が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Should I also change the name on my mail to match my relative's name on the nameplate?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you must change your own addressee name to match the nameplate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宛名の本人情報と、住居の表示は分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check your personal addressee details separately from the name displayed at the residence.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。私の名前を親族の名前に書き換えたくはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人名を親族名へ置換しない希望を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I don't want to replace my name with my relative's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Express that you do not want your name replaced with your relative's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 親族の方には、郵便を受け取ることを伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you told your relative that you will be receiving mail there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。私の名字も郵便受けに表示してよいと言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 親族の受取了承と名字併記許可を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. They said I could display my surname on the mailbox too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your relative agrees to receive your mail and allows your surname to be displayed too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状況を担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please explain that situation to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。住所は同じでも、本人の名前を残した書き方を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人名を残す宛名方法を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Even though the address is the same, I'll ask how to write it while keeping my own name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask how to address mail while retaining your own name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当が住所とお名前、住居の表示を確認します。親族名への置換えはせず、ご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: The person in charge will check the address, your name, and the display at the residence. Please consult them without substituting your relative's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: アプリのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the app?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通知がたくさんあります。消すと、通帳に残る取引まで消えてしまいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知削除が取引記録へ及ぶか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have lots of notifications. If I delete them, will the transactions recorded in my passbook disappear too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether deleting notifications affects transaction records. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知の表示と取引の記録は別に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the notification display and the transaction records separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分が整理したいのは通知だけです。取引を取り消したいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 整理目的と取引取消を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's only the notifications I want to organize. I'm not trying to cancel any transactions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish organizing notifications from canceling transactions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの画面を見ているか、ご本人の操作で示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you show us which screen you're viewing by operating it yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。この通知一覧です。残高の画面ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知一覧の画面を本人操作で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, this notification list. It isn't the balance screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Operate the app yourself to show the notification list screen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が操作の意味をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will explain what the operation does.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。削除のボタンを押す前に、消える範囲を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ボタン操作前に削除範囲を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Before I press the delete button, I'd like to know exactly what will disappear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what will be deleted before pressing the button. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な通知を残すご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Are there any notifications you want to keep?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。一件は相談中なので残します。全部を一括で消すつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相談中の一件を残す希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'm still consulting someone about one of them, so I'll keep that one. I don't intend to delete everything at once.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to keep the one still under consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通知一覧の扱いを担当が確認します。相談中の一件を区別して、操作前にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: The person in charge will check how the notification list works. Identify the one still under consultation, and check before operating it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの料理にお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: What dish will you use it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: スープです。この細い野菜は炒め物の写真がありますが、スープにも使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 表示料理と別用途での使用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Soup. These thinly cut vegetables have a photo of a stir-fry on them, but can I use them for soup too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about using a product for a dish other than the one shown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 使い方は選べますが、切り方が違う商品もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can choose how to use them, but some products are cut differently.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日は長く煮たいので、細すぎない物も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 長煮用の大きめカットを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to simmer them for a long time today, so I'd also like to see some that aren't cut too thinly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request larger cuts for prolonged simmering. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは大きめのカットです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: These are cut into larger pieces.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。写真どおりの料理を作らないといけないわけではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 商品写真の料理が必須でないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I don't have to make exactly the dish in the photo, do I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you do not have to make the dish in the product photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。表示の内容や保存方法もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. Please also check the label information and storage instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 量が多いので、一度で使い切れる小さい袋はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 使い切れる少量包装を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: That's a lot, so do you have a small bag I could use up in one go?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Look for a small package you can use up at once. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの容量なら少なめです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: This package contains a smaller amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、大きめに切った小袋にします。食べる人数に合わせて使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切り方と量を組み合わせて選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll take the small bag of larger-cut vegetables. I'll use an amount suited to the number of people eating.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose based on both the cut and the quantity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらですね。内容量と保存表示をご確認の上、お持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: This one, then. Please check the net quantity and storage label before taking it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: コースについてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the course?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族が走ります。私は歩くので、同じ周回を全部歩かなければ会えませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 走者と同周回でないと会えないか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family will be running. I'll be walking, so will I only be able to meet them if I walk the whole same loop?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you must complete the runner's entire loop to meet them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 待合せ場所を決めれば、別の範囲で歩くこともできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you agree on a meeting place, you can walk a different section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、私は短い区間で折り返し、同じ入口で会いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 短距離折返しと入口合流を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'd like to turn back after a short section and meet them at the same entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Suggest turning back after a short distance and meeting at the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 折返しで急に横切らないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please don't cross suddenly when you turn back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。周りを見て戻ります。走る家族にも、私を追いかける必要はないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 急な横断を避け追随不要を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll check my surroundings before heading back. I'll also tell my family running that they don't need to follow me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid crossing suddenly and explain that the runner need not follow you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 合流の時刻も決めてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you also agreed on a time to meet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。家族の周回数より、時計の時刻で決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 周回数でなく時刻を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I'll set a time on the clock rather than a number of laps for my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Set a clock time rather than a lap count. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口の名前を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please confirm the name of the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。この入口名と時刻をメッセージに書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口名と時刻で集合を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll put this entrance name and the time in a message.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the meeting using the entrance name and time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 別々の距離でも、待合せを明確にしてお楽しみください。折返し時は通行にお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Enjoy yourselves over your different distances, with clear meeting arrangements. Please watch out for other people when turning back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 近い出口をご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like directions to the nearest exit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、迎えの車が来ます。近いだけで選ぶと会えないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 距離優先と迎え合流の両立を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, but a car is coming to pick me up. If I choose just because it's near, we might miss each other.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss balancing a nearby exit with meeting your ride. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 車でのお迎えの場所を確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked where the car will pick you up?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人は反対側と言っています。出口名はまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 迎え側の出口名が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend says it's on the opposite side. I haven't asked the exit name yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you don't know the exit name on the pickup side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 出口の名前と、停車できる場所を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please confirm the exit name and where the car can stop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。私が近い出口へ先に出ず、友人の返事を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出口移動を返答まで保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll wait for my friend's reply instead of going out through the nearest exit first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Wait for a reply before moving to an exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 大きい鞄があります。返事が来たら、階段の少ない経路も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 重い鞄を理由に階段少なめを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a large bag. Once the reply comes, I'd also like to know a route with fewer stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a route with fewer stairs because of your heavy bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出口が決まってから経路をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll explain the route once the exit is decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。出口と乗る場所を同じ意味にしないで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出口と車への乗車場所を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll check without treating the exit and the place to get into the car as the same thing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the exit from the place where you will board the car. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 出口名がわかりましたらお知らせください。そこまでの経路と、お迎え場所を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let me know when you know the exit name. Let's check the route there separately from the pickup location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 新しい住所の記入でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you filling in your new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。今は宿に泊まっていますが、住む部屋は別です。どちらを書くのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一時宿泊先と新居の記入先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'm staying at a lodging place now, but the room I'll live in is elsewhere. Which address should I write?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to enter your temporary lodging address or your new home address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際の居住状況を担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check your actual living situation with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 部屋の契約はありますが、荷物を入れるのは来週です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 契約済みと入居前を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've signed a contract for the room, but I won't move my belongings in until next week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have a contract but haven't moved in yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今のお話を担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the person in charge what you've just explained.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。宿泊開始日と入居予定日を分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宿泊日と入居予定日を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll explain the date I started staying at the lodging place separately from my planned move-in date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the lodging start date from the planned move-in date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住所の資料はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have documents showing the address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 契約書の住所を持っています。宿の住所と混ぜずに見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新居住所の資料を別に示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the address on the contract. I'll show it separately, without mixing it up with the lodging address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the documents for your new home address separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まだ住所欄は記入しないでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is it all right to leave the address field blank for now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。私が推測で宿の住所を書く前に、確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当確認まで住所記入を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'd like to check before guessing and writing the lodging address myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait for the person in charge to confirm before entering the address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 居住状況の相談としてご案内します。二つの住所と日程の資料を担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll direct you to someone to discuss your living situation. Please show the person in charge documents for both addresses and the dates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約を変更されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to change your appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日付は変えません。「早めに来る」と言われましたが、予約時刻も変わったのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約変更でなく早着指示の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm not changing the date. I was told to come early, but has the appointment time changed too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what the instruction to arrive early means, rather than requesting an appointment change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 検査前の準備で来院時間が別に指定される場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sometimes a separate arrival time is specified for preparation before a test.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、診察予約と受付に来る時間を分けて確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 診察予約と来院時間を分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'd like to check my medical appointment time separately from the time I should arrive at reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the medical appointment and arrival time separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内の紙はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have the instruction sheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: これです。予約は午後ですが、来院欄には午前の時刻があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紙上の午前午後差を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. The appointment is in the afternoon, but the arrival field shows a morning time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point out the morning and afternoon difference on the sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。午後だけ見て来ると、準備に間に合わないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 午後来院による準備不足を懸念する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. If I look only at the afternoon time when coming, I might not arrive in time for the preparation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Express concern that an afternoon arrival may leave insufficient time for preparation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご確認後に予定を調整してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please adjust your plans after confirming.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。仕事には予約時刻でなく、必要な来院時刻から休みを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要来院時間に合わせ勤務調整する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll discuss taking time off work based on the required arrival time, rather than the appointment time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Adjust your work schedule to the required arrival time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者へ確認します。予約日を変更せず、来院指示の意味をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-16209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check with the person in charge. We'll explain the arrival instructions without changing the appointment date.
